name: @zkuat/cli
description: zkuat CLI — anchor, prove, status. The fallback proof path: everything the browser demo does, from a terminal.
comment:midnight-sdk: No @midnight-ntwrk/* dependency here, for the same reason as in anchor/: a second copy of the SDK's WASM module means a second class registry, and the first circuit call dies with `expected instance of StateValue`. Everything on-chain goes through @zkuat/anchor, which reaches the SDK through contract/src/devnet/sdk.ts.
